sections.title: 2.4 User characteristics
sections.text_preview: The users of the PMS are expected to be academic personnel and students with various technical backgrounds. All the users should have a basic knowledge of the internet.

sections.title: 2.5 Constraints

• The users must have a web browser that supports W3C XHTML [3] and have a TCP/IP connection to the web server.

• The http trafic must be possible on the network connection between server and client.
